archive.restoration_rule: The public current-release URL is mutable. Changed bytes fail identity checks; obtain the pinned 2023 snapshot or explicitly review a new release rather than substituting it silently.

column_map_source: LCDB 2023 README section 4.1.3; period-quality interpretation sections 4.1.2 and 4.1.6.

rights.citation: Warner, B.D., Harris, A.W., Pravec, P. (2009), Icarus 202, 134–146. Updated 1 October 2023.
rights.status: Public files distributed for general research use with requested citation; the site retains copyright. No blanket raw-data redistribution license is asserted. Only factual derived coverage and selected rotational fields are included here; raw archives remain ignored.

reading_rule: Period quality measures solution reliability, not resource grade or all underlying data quality. Greater/less-than/uncertain flags, survey and unpublished flags remain attached. A quality-2 solution can have substantial or integer-ratio error. Binary/tumbling notes require detail/original-record review; blank flags do not establish a single non-tumbling body. No contact-binary status is inferred. LCDB sizes/albedos/taxonomies may be assumed and are deliberately not imported. Unmatched objects remain unknown; the source predates the retained JPL catalogue.
